_rule: An entry needs a primary source URL and an as-of date. No entry => the tax block is hidden. Never copy a state default or another city's rate. Combined = state + local (where county + city + specialDistrict == local); HSV covers the Garland County portion only.

tx/austin.source: Texas Comptroller city sales tax rate table (Austin, Travis Co.: 6.25% state + 1.0% city + 1.0% Capital Metro MTA)

id/boise.source: Idaho State Tax Commission (6% state; no Boise local sales tax)

fl/tampa.source: Florida Dept. of Revenue discretionary sales surtax (6.0% state + 1.5% Hillsborough County)

az/scottsdale.source: City of Scottsdale tax resources (5.6% state + 0.7% Maricopa County + 1.70% city, effective 2025-07-01)

tn/nashville.source: Tennessee Dept. of Revenue Notice 24-11 (Davidson County local rate 2.75% from 2025-02-01 + 7.0% state)

ok/oklahoma-city.source: City of Oklahoma City (4.5% state + 4.125% city = 8.625%)

ar/hot-springs-village.source: Arkansas Dept. of Finance and Administration local sales & use tax table (Garland County unincorporated portion: 6.5% state + 1.5% Garland County = 8.0%; Saline County portion may differ)

ar/hot-springs.source: Arkansas Dept. of Finance and Administration local sales & use tax table (6.5% state + 1.5% Garland County + 1.5% City of Hot Springs = 9.5%)
